messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx observed on inference-api (api-gateway-prod). 5xx rate 5m avg jumped to ~6%. Multiple downstream services reporting 429 fanout. Paging on-call.

oncall-jamal: on call, ack. pulling metrics now.

ops-bot: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/Infernce/overview?from=now-15m&to=now — 5xx spike aligns with 12:03 UTC. 429s rising on quota-service and auth-proxy.

sre-maya: looking at recent config publishes — saw a rollout for tenant-spike-protect v2 at 12:02 UTC. This was supposed to be canary but flag says "global": true.

eng-sara: yep that was my deploy. I pushed canary -> global by mistake when flipping the gate. intended scope: alpha-tenants only. re-opening PR now. :facepalm:

oncall-jamal: ok primary hypothesis: global quota policy applied -> gateway started rejecting then downstream services retried -> increased load -> 502/504s. immediate mitigation: disable quota enforcement at gateway to stop 429 cascade.

oncall-jamal: running command to toggle enforcement (prod gateway):
```
kubectl exec -n prod gateway-ctl -- curl -s -XPOST http://localhost:8080/_admin/feature_flags \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"quota_enforcement": false, "reason":"incident-mitigation"}'
```

ops-bot: feature flag update accepted, propagation to all gateway instances in progress.

ops-bot: metrics update: 429s dropping from 18% -> 1.2% in last 90s. 5xx trending down but still elevated ~1.6%.

infra-liam: scaling gateway to absorb backlog: `kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=12 -n prod` — pods spinning up.

eng-sara: initiating rollback of tenant-spike-protect release from helm: `helm rollback tenant-spike-protect 3 --namespace platform` (undo global publish).

product-ryan: customer impact: support funnel shows 17 customers with >50 failed requests each during 12:03-12:11 UTC. Top affected: tenant-442 (large-volume), tenant-778. Notified CS.

sre-maya: seeing a secondary effect: frontend had automatic retry on 429 that retried aggressively. disabled retry policy to prevent requeue storm. Patch applied to frontend-config map.

oncall-jamal: applied targeted tenant bypass for tenant-442 to drain requests while infra scales:
```
PATCH /admin/tenants/442 HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.internal
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "bypass_quota": true,
  "reason": "incident mitigation"
}
```

ops-bot: bypass acknowledged. traffic for tenant-442 is routing through bypass path. error count for that tenant falling.

infra-liam: new gateway pods healthy. CPU/req latency normalizing. backlog queue length down 85%.

eng-sara: rollback confirmed, tenant-spike-protect v2 no longer active. I'm opening a hotfix PR to add rollout safeguards (explicit canary gating + manual confirm on global).

product-ryan: CS update: sent interim notification to 17 impacted customers, providing ETA: 30m to full normalization, offering credits where SLA breached.

oncall-jamal: monitoring for 15m window. if stable, we close page and file followups: postmortem, add alert for accidental global feature flips, reduce frontend retry aggressiveness, add an automated check that disallows global toggles unless flag owner approves.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial recovery. Pager cleared.
